POSE_1: OK. Stable base, balanced spine, natural limb positions.
POSE_2: ISSUE. Unstable balance, legs splayed awkwardly, unnatural spine curve.
POSE_3: OK. Balanced stance, natural arm extension, stable feet.
POSE_4: OK. Dynamic but balanced posture, limbs in motion, spine aligned.
POSE_5: ISSUE. Off-center balance, twisted spine, awkward leg placement.
POSE_6: ISSUE. Leaning too far forward, unstable base, unnatural spinal arch.
